title: Baa Juice Apple Watermelon Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Apple Watermelon Shortfill pairs two classic fruits in a refreshing high-VG blend. Juicy Watermelon brings its mellow sweetness while crisp Apple adds a sharper bite, together creating a bright, well-rounded fruit vape. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills use double-concentrated flavouring for vivid, long-lasting taste, with fruit profiles designed to satisfy vapers who enjoy punchy blends.
